blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Agent memory systems such as Mem0 and Zep decide what to keep before any question arrives; coding agents keep the raw history and let the model search it with its own tools. We ask whether designed memory still helps once the model is strong enough to search for itself. On one LoCoMo conversation (419 turns, 152 questions), we run four memory methods (full context, BM25, Mem0, Zep) and three coding agents (Pi, Codex, Claude Code), each with GPT-4o-mini, GPT-6 Luna and Claude Opus 5.5, and record what every rollout costs. This is a short empirical study, with one conversation and one run per cell. Agent memory is a costly patch for a weak model: Mem0 beats full context only with GPT-4o-mini, and its build alone costs more than a whole full-context rollout. Agent memory also has a ceiling, set by the model that writes it: a stronger reader does not recover what a weaker writer left out. With Claude Opus 5.5, Pi tops the cost-accuracy frontier, scoring 99% for less than half the cost of full context; its one miss is a wrong answer key. Part of that lead comes from photo captions that only the agents could read: on the 88 questions whose evidence has no photo, Pi and full context differ by one answer.
blocks.zh: Mem0和Zep等代理内存系统在任何问题到来之前决定保留什么;编码代理保存了原始历史,让模型用自己的工具来搜索. 我们问,一旦模型足够强大,可以自行搜索,设计记忆是否仍然有帮助. 在一次LoCoMo对话(419转,152个问题)上,我们运行了四个内存方法(完整上下文,BM25,Mem0,Zep)和三个编码代理(Pi,Codex,Claude Code),每个代号与GPT-4-mini,GPT-6 Luna和Claude Opus 5.5,并记录每个推出成本. 这是一个简短的经验性研究,每个细胞有一个对话和一个运行. 代理内存对于弱模型来说是一个代价高昂的补丁: Mem0只用GPT-4o-mini来打出完整的上下文,单是它的建设就比整个完整上下文的推出要花费更多. 代理记忆也有一个天花板,由写作它的模型设定:一个更强大的读者无法恢复一个更弱小的作家所遗漏的东西. 与克洛德·奥普斯5.5,Pi在成本准确度前沿上位,得分99%,不足全上下文成本的一半;其一错就是错误的答案键. 部分线索来自只有特工才能读取的照片标题:在证据没有照片的88个问题上,皮和整个上下文因一个答案而不同.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Agent memory systems such as Mem0 and Zep decide what to keep before any question arrives: the model extracts facts or builds a graph from the conversation, and each question sees a few retrieved pieces [ 1 , 2 ] . Coding agents and recursive language models keep the raw history instead and let the model search it with its own tools [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: Mem0和Zep等代理内存系统在任何疑问到来之前决定保留什么:模型从对话中提取事实或构建一个图表,每个问题都看到一些检索到的棋子[1,2]. 编码代理和递归语言模型保存原始历史,让模型用自己的工具进行搜索[3,4,5,6].

blocks.en: The bitter lesson is that knowledge built into a system helps at first, then plateaus, while general methods that scale with computation win [ 7 ] . Agent memory builds in what to keep. Does it still help once the model is strong enough to search for itself?
blocks.zh: 痛苦的教训是,一个系统所蕴含的知识一开始帮助了高原,而一般方法则通过计算得胜来衡量。 代理内存是用来保存的 如果模型足够坚固 足以自我搜索,它还能帮助吗?

blocks.en: We run four memory methods (full context, BM25 [ 8 ] , Mem0 and Zep) and three coding agents (Pi, Codex and Claude Code), each with GPT-4o-mini, GPT-6 Luna and Claude Opus 5.5, on a conversation from LoCoMo [ 9 ] , and measure what each run costs. We find:
blocks.zh: 我们运行了四种内存方法(完整上下文,BM25 [8],Mem0和Zep)和三种编码代理(Pi,Codex和Claude Code),每一种与GPT-4o-mini,GPT-6 Luna和Claude Opus 5.5,在LoCoMo[9]的一次交谈中,并测量每个运行成本. 我们发现:

blocks.en: • Agent memory is a costly patch for a weak model. Mem0 beats full context only with GPT-4o-mini, and its build alone costs more than full context’s whole run (Section 3 ). • Agent memory has a ceiling, set by the model that writes it. A stronger reader does not recover what a weaker writer left out (Section 4 ). • With Claude Opus 5.5, Pi tops the cost–accuracy frontier (Figure 1 ). It answers every question whose answer key is sound, for less than half what full context costs. Where the two read the same text they differ by one answer; the rest of Pi’s lead comes from photo captions that only the agents could read (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh: • 支助 代理内存对于弱模型来说是一个代价高昂的补丁. Mem0只用GPT-4o-mini来超越整个背景, • 代理内存有一个上限,由写它的模式设定。 较强的读者无法恢复较弱作家所遗漏的东西(第4节)。 • 与克劳德·奥普斯·5.5相比,Pi是成本-准确性前沿(图1)。 它回答了每一个问题,其答案是健全的,但不到全部上下文成本的一半。 当两人读到相同的文字时,它们因一个答案而不同;皮的其余铅来自只有特工才能读到的照片字幕(第5节)。

blocks.en: Agent memory is a costly patch for a weak model. Mem0 beats full context only with GPT-4o-mini, and its build alone costs more than full context’s whole run (Section 3 ).
blocks.zh: 代理内存对于弱模型来说是一个代价高昂的补丁. Mem0只用GPT-4o-mini来超越整个背景,

blocks.en: Agent memory has a ceiling, set by the model that writes it. A stronger reader does not recover what a weaker writer left out (Section 4 ).
blocks.zh: 代理记忆有一个天花板,由写它的模式设定. 较强的读者无法恢复较弱作家所遗漏的东西(第4节)。

blocks.en: With Claude Opus 5.5, Pi tops the cost–accuracy frontier (Figure 1 ). It answers every question whose answer key is sound, for less than half what full context costs. Where the two read the same text they differ by one answer; the rest of Pi’s lead comes from photo captions that only the agents could read (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh: 与Claude Opus 5.5, Pi 最高成本-精确前沿(图1). 它回答了每一个问题,其答案是健全的,但不到全部上下文成本的一半。 当两人读到相同的文字时,它们因一个答案而不同;皮的其余铅来自只有特工才能读到的照片字幕(第5节)。

blocks.en: The study is small: one conversation, one run per cell, and a GPT-4o-mini judge. Section 6 lists what it cannot show. Within those limits, the results suggest that a strong model needs less designed memory and better tools for searching the raw record.
blocks.zh: 研究规模小:一次谈话,每间牢房运行一次,以及一名GBT-4o-mini法官. 第6节列出了它无法显示的内容。 在这些限度内,结果表明,一个强大的模型需要设计较少的内存和更好的原始记录检索工具。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Cost and correct rate per rollout. Each badge is one cell’s whole run: the build, then all 152 questions. Colour is the model, the badge the method’s mark, and a letter in the badge marks a method without one (F full context, B BM25). The stepped line is the highest correct rate reached at or below each cost, and the labelled cells lie on it. Cost is on a log axis.
blocks.zh: 图1:每次推出的费用和正确率。 每个徽章都是一个牢房的全程:建筑,然后是所有152个问题。 颜色是模型,徽章是方法的标记,徽章中的一个字母标记了一种没有一种方法(F全上下文,B BM25). 阶梯线是每个成本达到或低于的最高正确速率,标注的细胞就位于它上. 成本在日志轴上。

blocks.en: 2 Setup
blocks.zh: 2 设置

blocks.en: We run 21 cells, seven methods with three models each, on LoCoMo conv-26 [ 9 ] : 419 turns in 19 sessions and 152 single-hop, multi-hop, temporal and open-domain questions. LoCoMo’s adversarial questions are left out, as in Mem0’s evaluation [ 1 ] . The history fits every model’s context window. Among the ten LoCoMo conversations, conv-26’s per-method accuracies track those of the full set closely. Table 1 lists the methods.
blocks.zh: 我们在LoCoMo conv-26上运行了21个单元格,7个方法,每个单元有3个型号,在LoCoMo conv-26[9]上: 419个回合共19场,152个单跳,多跳,时空和开放域问题. LoCoMo的对抗性问题被忽略, 历史符合每个模型的背景窗口。 在十次LoCoMo对话中, 表1列出了方法。

blocks.en: Table 1: Methods: what each stores and what the model sees when it answers.
blocks.zh: 表1:方法:每个模型在回答时所储存的东西和所看到的东西.

blocks.en: The memory methods answer one question at a time with Mem0’s 2025 answer template; Mem0 is OSS 2.1.0 and Zep is Graphiti OSS 0.30.2, both with default extraction and retrieval [ 1 , 2 ] . The agents, Pi 1.1.0, Codex 0.159.2 and Claude Code 2.1.295 [ 3 , 4 , 5 ] , start a fresh session in a fresh container for each question, with the conversation as one file, their default tools, and the template’s answer rules in the prompt (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 内存方法用Mem0的2025年答题模板一次回答一个问题;Mem0是OSS 2.1.0,Zep是Graphiti OSS 0.30.2,两者都有默认提取和检索[1,2]. Pi 1.1.0, Codex 0.159.2和Claude Code 2.1.295 [3, 4, 5] 代理商为每个问题在一个新鲜的容器中开始一个新鲜的会话,对话作为一个文件,他们的默认工具,模板的解答规则在即时(附录C).

blocks.en: The models go from weak to strongest: GPT-4o-mini, GPT-6 Luna, Claude Opus 5.5. The last two run at reasoning effort high, the effort coding agents are usually run at [ 10 ] ; GPT-4o-mini has no effort setting. In each cell one model writes the store (Mem0, Zep) and answers every question, or drives the agent.
blocks.zh: 模型从弱变强:GPT-4o-mini,GPT-6 Luna,克劳德·奥普斯 5.5. 最后两个运行在推理努力高,努力编码代理通常运行在[10];GPT-4o-mini没有努力设置. 每个单元格中有一个模型写商店(Mem0,Zep)并回答每个问题,或者驱动代理.

blocks.en: Some LoCoMo turns share a photo, and the official file holds a caption of it next to the turn text. The agents get the official file, captions included; the memory methods were given the turn text only. 116 of the 419 turns share a photo, and 64 of the 152 questions have evidence in such a turn. Section 5 measures what this changes.
blocks.zh: 一些LoCoMo转身分享一张照片,官方文件在转身文本旁边有其标题. 代理员得到官方文件,包括标题;内存方法只得到转折文本. 419个回合中有116个分享照片,152个问题中有64个有证据。 第5节衡量这一变化。

blocks.en: A rollout is one run over the conversation: the build, then the 152 questions. GPT-4o-mini grades every answer with Mem0’s 2025 judge rubric [ 1 ] ; empty answers count as wrong. Cost is the list price of every model call, LLM and embedding (text-embedding-3-small), with the judge excluded. A turn is one LLM call: one per question for the memory methods, one per step of an agent’s loop, and Mem0’s and Zep’s calls to build their store. Tokens are those calls’ input and output tokens, cached input included; embeddings are not counted. Each cell runs once.
blocks.zh: 推开就是一连串的谈话:建筑,然后是152个问题。 GPT-4o-mini的分数每一次答题, 成本是每个模式调用、LLM和嵌入(文本-嵌入-3-小)的列表价格,法官除外。 一个转弯是一个LLM呼叫:每个问题一个关于内存方法,一个代理环路的每个步骤,一个Mem0和Zep的呼号来建立他们的商店. 插件是这些调用输入和输出的符号,包含缓存输入;嵌入不计数. 每个细胞运行一次。

blocks.en: 3 Agent memory is a costly patch for a weak model
blocks.zh: 3个 代理内存对于一个弱型号来说是一个昂贵的补丁

blocks.en: With GPT-4o-mini, Mem0 scores highest. It scores 78%, against 74% for both full context and BM25; Zep scores 43%. The agents score 63% (Pi), 28% (Codex) and 29% (Claude Code): Codex opens the conversation file for three questions in four and Claude Code almost never, and otherwise they answer from the question alone.
blocks.zh: 和GPT -4O -米尼, Mem0分数最高. 它的得分是78%,而全上下文和BM25的得分是74%;Zep的得分是43%. 代理商得分63%(Pi),28%(Codex)和29%(Claude Code): Codex打开谈话文件,在4个问题中3个,Claude Code几乎从来没有,否则他们只从问题中回答.

blocks.en: With the two stronger models, the patch stops helping. With GPT-6 Luna, full context scores 92%, BM25 82%, Mem0 80% and Zep 51%; Zep’s graph holds 128 facts from the 19 sessions, against 195 with Claude Opus 5.5. With Claude Opus 5.5, Mem0 and full context both score 95% and Zep 87%, and the agents score highest: Pi 99%, Codex 98% and Claude Code 97%, a lead that comes mostly from questions about photos (Section 5 ). Earlier work also finds that plain retrieval keeps up with elaborate memory [ 11 ] and that rankings between memory systems change with the model [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 随着两个更强大的模型,补丁停止帮助. 与GPT-6 Luna相比,完整上下文得分92%,BM25 82%,Mem0 80%和Zep 51%;Zep的图中存有19届的128个事实,与克劳德·奥普斯5.5的195个事实相对. 与克劳德·奥普斯(Claude Opus)5.5,Mem0和全上下文同时得分95%和Zep 87%,代理商得分最高:Pi 99%,Codex 98%和Claude Code 97%,这一线索主要来自对照片的质疑(第5节). 早期的工作还发现,平版检索与精心的内存保持了同步[11],内存系统之间的排名也随着模型[12]而变化.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Cumulative cost–correct curves. Each curve is one rollout: the build, then the questions from cheapest to most expensive (equal costs grouped), adding up cost and correct answers; correct answers are divided by 152, so a wrong answer adds cost only. Colour is the model, the badge the method, and agents are dotted. The cost axis is linear to $2 and logarithmic above. Curves use a nine-point moving average, and the badges mark the unsmoothed totals of Table 2 . Strong lines are cells that no other cell beats on both cost and correct answers.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 累计成本-正确曲线。 每条曲线都是一个展开的:建造,然后从最便宜到最昂贵的问题(平均成本分组),将成本加起来,正确答案;正确的答案除以152,所以错误答案只增加成本. 颜色是模型,徽章是方法,代理被点缀. 成本轴为线性至2美元,上方为对数. 曲线采用9点移动平均值,徽章标注表2的未滑动总数. 强线是没有其它细胞在成本和正确答案上都击败的细胞.

blocks.en: The patch is not free. Mem0’s build alone costs more than full context’s whole rollout with the same model: $0.56 against $0.43 with GPT-4o-mini, $0.45 against $0.29 with GPT-6 Luna and $25.88 against $17.84 with Claude Opus 5.5 (Figure 2 ). Its questions are cheaper, so the build would pay for itself after 372, 545 and 596 questions on the same history; LoCoMo asks 152. Mem0 and Zep are never on the frontier of Figure 1 , which runs through BM25 and full context with GPT-6 Luna and Pi with Claude Opus 5.5. Paying to build memory that a stronger model does not need is a memory tax.
blocks.zh: 补丁不自由. Mem0的建造成本超过同一型号的全环境推出费用:用GPT-4o-mini的0.56美元对0.43美元,用GPT-6 Luna的0.45美元对0.29美元,用Claude Opus 5.5的17.84美元(图2)对25.88美元。 其质疑更便宜,因此在372年,545年和596年的同一历史问题之后,该建筑会为自己付出代价;LoCoMo询问152. Mem0和Zep从未出现在图1的前沿,图1贯穿BM25,与GPT-6 Luna和Pi与克劳德·奥普斯5.5. 为建立更强大的模型不需要的记忆而付费的是记忆税.

blocks.en: 4 Agent memory has a ceiling
blocks.zh: 页:1 代理内存有天花板

blocks.en: The model that writes the store limits every reader. Mem0 and Zep write their store with the same model that later reads it. Retrieval calls no language model, so the reader can be swapped: each model answers from the retrievals of the others’ stores (Figure 3 , Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 写商店的模型限制了每个读者. Mem0和Zep用后来读取的模型来写他们的商店. 检索没有调用语言模型,所以读者可以互换:从其他商店检索到的每个模型答案(图3,表3).

blocks.en: Figure 3: Writer and reader. Each colour is one store, written by that model. The filled badge is the writer reading its own store, and arrows run from it to the other two readers.
blocks.zh: 图3:作家和读者。 每个颜色都是一个商店,由那个模型书写。 填充的徽章是作家阅读自己的商店,箭头从它跑到其他两个读者.

blocks.en: A stronger reader does not recover what the writer left out. On Zep’s GPT-4o-mini graph, GPT-4o-mini, GPT-6 Luna and Claude Opus 5.5 score 43%, 43% and 45%; on the graph Claude Opus 5.5 wrote, 66%, 71% and 87%. Mem0 keeps the order with smaller gaps: 78%, 83% and 84% from GPT-4o-mini’s store, 89%, 91% and 95% from Claude Opus 5.5’s. This agrees with work where verbatim chunks beat extracted facts on long conversations [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 更强大的读者无法恢复作家留下的东西. 在Zep的GPT-4o-mini图上,GPT-4o-mini,GPT-6 Luna和Claude Opus 5.5的得分是43%,43%和45%;在图上Claude Opus 5.5写道,66%,71%和87%. Mem0保持了较小的差距:GPT-4o-mini商店的78%、83%和84%,Claude Opus 5.5商店的89%、91%和95%。 这与在长篇谈话中逐字逐句总结事实的工作是一致的。

blocks.en: 5 With Claude Opus 5.5, Pi tops the frontier
blocks.zh: 5 与克劳德·奥普斯5.5, 皮在前沿领先

blocks.en: Pi with Claude Opus 5.5 is the top of the frontier in Figure 1 . No other cell scores higher: Pi scores 99% for $6.95 a rollout, while full context with the same model scores 95% for $17.84. Pi reads about 10,000 input tokens a question, 7,900 of them cached, against 28,900 for full context. Codex and Claude Code score 98% and 97% for $25.41 and $28.41; HarnessTax explains why the same model costs so differently across harnesses [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: Pi和Claude Opus 5.5在图1中位居前沿第一. 没有其它单元格分数更高 : Pi在推出6.95美元时得分99%,而同一型号的全部上下文在17.84美元时得分95%. Pi读了大约10,000个输入符 一个问题,其中7,900个被缓存,而28,900个完整上下文. Codex和Claude Code以25.41美元和28.41美元分别得分98%和97%;HarnessTax解释了为什么同一型号在不同的吊带上成本如此不同[10].

blocks.en: Its one miss is LoCoMo’s mistake. The question asks what kind of painting Caroline shared with Melanie on 13 October 2023, and the answer key says an abstract painting with blue streaks. In the conversation it is Melanie who shares that painting; Caroline shares a drawing. Pi says so and is marked wrong: “Caroline shared a drawing, not a painting. … The paintings shared that day (a sunset and an abstract piece) were Melanie’s.” With Claude Opus 5.5, full context, Codex and Claude Code point out the same mistake and are marked wrong too. On the other 151 questions, Pi with Claude Opus 5.5 is always right.
blocks.zh: 其唯一失误是LoCoMo的错误。 质疑2023年10月13日卡罗琳与梅兰妮分享的画作是什么样的,答案键上写着一幅带有蓝色花纹的抽象画. 在谈话中,是梅兰妮分享那幅画;卡罗琳分享一幅画. Pi这样说,并被标记错了:“Caroline分享了一幅画,而不是一幅画。 这幅画是梅兰妮的作品。 与克劳德·奥普斯5.5(英语:Claude Opus 5.5)的完整上下文,Codex和Claude Code(英语:Claude Code)指出了同样的错误,并且也标记错了. 关于其他151个问题,皮与克劳德·奥普斯5.5总是对的.

blocks.en: Photo captions account for most of Pi’s lead over full context. With Claude Opus 5.5, Pi answers seven questions that full context misses and misses none that it answers. Six of the seven have their evidence in a turn that shares a photo, whose caption Pi could read and full context could not (Section 2 ); so do all six such questions for Codex and all four for Claude Code. On the 88 questions without photo evidence, Pi scores 100%, and full context, Mem0, Codex and Claude Code 99% each (Table 4 ). With the same input, then, Pi matches full context for less than half its cost. Whether searching the record answers more than reading all of it, this study does not settle.
blocks.zh: 图片字幕占据了Pi在完整语境上的主导地位。 与Claude Opus 5.5, 皮回答七个问题, 七人中有六人有证据轮流分享一张照片,其标题Pi可以读,完整上下文不能读(第2节);Codex的所有六个问题和Claude Code的所有四个问题也是如此。 在88个没有照片证据的问题上,Pi得分100%,完整上下文Mem0,Codex和Claude代码各99%(表4). 有了同样的输入,Pi就与其成本不足一半的完整上下文匹配. 查找记录是否比阅读所有记录更能回答问题,本研究没有解决.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: Our results suggest that agent memory is a costly patch for a weak model and caps what any reader can answer. On this LoCoMo conversation, Mem0 helps GPT-4o-mini but not GPT-6 Luna or Claude Opus 5.5, a stronger reader does not recover what the writer left out, and with Claude Opus 5.5 Pi answers every sound question for less than full context costs.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,代理记忆对于一个弱型模型来说是一个代价高昂的补丁,并且封顶了任何读者都能回答的问题. 在LoCoMo的谈话中,Mem0帮助GPT-4o-mini,但不是GPT-6 Luna或Claude Opus 5.5,一个更强大的读者无法恢复编剧留下的东西,和Claude Opus 5.5 Pi一起以低于全部上下文成本的方式回答每个声音问题.

blocks.en: The findings rest on a small study, and these limits apply: • Scale. One conversation of LoCoMo’s ten, and one run per cell. Differences of a few questions may not hold in a second run. • Grading. A GPT-4o-mini judge with a lenient rubric, and at least one wrong answer key. • Photo captions. The agents could read photo captions that the memory methods were not given (Section 5 ). This touches comparisons between agents and memory methods, not those among the memory methods. • Context length. The history fits in every model’s context window, so full context is always an option. Results may differ on other benchmarks such as LongMemEval [ 14 ] and on histories that do not fit. • Settings and prices. Mem0 and Zep run with their default extraction and retrieval, and other settings may do better. Costs are list prices and depend on each provider’s caching.
blocks.zh: 研究结果仅依靠一项小研究,这些限制适用: • 规模。 LoCoMo的十人交谈, 几个问题之间的分歧可能不会在第二轮中存在。 • 升级。 一个GPT -4o -mini法官 带有宽大的标题 至少一个错误的答案键。 • 图片字幕。 这些代理人可以阅读没有给出内存方法的照片标题(第5节)。 这触及代理和内存方法之间的比较,而不是内存方法中的比较. • 背景长度。 历史符合每个模型的上下文窗口,因此完整上下文总是一种选择。 在其他基准,如LongMemEval[14]和不适合使用的历史方面,结果可能有所不同。 • 设置和价格。 Mem0和Zep用他们的默认提取和检索运行,其他设置可能做得更好. 成本是清单价格,取决于每个提供者的缓存。

blocks.en: Scale. One conversation of LoCoMo’s ten, and one run per cell. Differences of a few questions may not hold in a second run.
blocks.zh: 规模。 LoCoMo的十人交谈, 几个问题之间的分歧可能不会在第二轮中存在。

blocks.en: Grading. A GPT-4o-mini judge with a lenient rubric, and at least one wrong answer key.
blocks.zh: 渐渐. 一个GPT -4o -mini法官 带有宽大的标题 至少一个错误的答案键。

blocks.en: Photo captions. The agents could read photo captions that the memory methods were not given (Section 5 ). This touches comparisons between agents and memory methods, not those among the memory methods.
blocks.zh: 图片标题。 这些代理人可以阅读没有给出内存方法的照片标题(第5节)。 这触及代理和内存方法之间的比较,而不是内存方法中的比较.

blocks.en: Context length. The history fits in every model’s context window, so full context is always an option. Results may differ on other benchmarks such as LongMemEval [ 14 ] and on histories that do not fit.
blocks.zh: 上下文长. 历史符合每个模型的上下文窗口,因此完整上下文总是一种选择。 在其他基准,如LongMemEval[14]和不适合使用的历史方面,结果可能有所不同。

blocks.en: Settings and prices. Mem0 and Zep run with their default extraction and retrieval, and other settings may do better. Costs are list prices and depend on each provider’s caching.
blocks.zh: 设置与价格. Mem0和Zep用他们的默认提取和检索运行,其他设置可能做得更好. 成本是清单价格,取决于每个提供者的缓存。

blocks.en: Memory systems and harnesses can also be searched for automatically [ 15 , 16 ] , but what is found is still fixed before the question arrives. More broadly, a strong model may need less designed memory and better tools: exact, semantic and vector search over the raw record, driven by the model itself [ 3 , 4 ] . Progress may then look less like another memory system and more like ripgrep after grep [ 17 ] , or zvec-grep after ripgrep [ 18 ] . Designed memory may survive as a cost trade-off when many questions share one history (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 记忆系统与带也可以自动搜索[15,16],但发现的东西在问题到来之前仍然固定. 更广泛地说,一个强大的模型可能需要设计较少的内存和更好的工具:精确的,语义的和矢量的对原始记录的搜索,由模型本身驱动[3,4]. 进步可能看起来不像另一个内存系统,更像是grep[17]之后的rigrep,或者rigrep[18]之后的zvec-grep. 当许多问题共享一个历史(图2)时,设计的记忆可能作为一种成本权衡而存活下来。

blocks.en: Mem0 OSS 2.1.0 writes one chronological turn at a time and retrieves k = 200 k=200 without reranking; dates are prepended to the text. Zep runs Graphiti OSS 0.30.2 on Kuzu, one session per episode, with hybrid edge search (top 20). The memory methods’ GPT-6 Luna and Claude Opus 5.5 requests set reasoning effort high.
blocks.zh: Mem0 OSS 2.1.0 一次写一个时间顺序转动,不重排就检索 k = 200 k = 200;日期为文本预留. Zep在Kuzu上运行Graphiti OSS 0.30.2,每集一个会话,同时进行混合边缘搜索(上20). 记忆方法的GPT-6 Luna和Claude Opus 5.5要求将推理工作定得很高。

blocks.en: Each agent question is a Harbor 0.24.0 task [ 19 ] : a fresh container holding only the conversation, exactly as in the official file, without questions or answers. The agent’s last message is its answer. While the agent runs, the container can reach only the model endpoint. GPT-6 Luna and Claude Opus 5.5 run at reasoning effort high, through a proxy that translates the API where an agent does not speak the model’s own; GPT-4o-mini has no effort setting. Codex and Claude Code have web search off; Pi has none. A question may take 20 minutes, and Pi and Claude Code at most 100 turns. With GPT-6 Luna, Codex picks its code mode: one JavaScript tool that calls the shell. A trial that fails or ends without an answer is run again, and only the accepted trial is counted.
blocks.zh: 每个特工提问都是港湾0.24.0任务[19]:新鲜的容器只保留对话,与官方档案完全相同,没有问答. 代理商的最后一个信息就是它的答案. 在代理运行期间,容器只能到达模型端点. GPT-6 Luna和Claude Opus 5.5通过一个代理翻译API, 代理商不会说模型自己的话;GPT-4o-mini没有努力设置。 Codex和Claude代码有网络搜索功能;Pi没有. 一个问题可能需要20分钟,皮和克劳德密码最多100转. 与GPT-6 Luna一起,Codex选择它的代码模式:一个叫 shell的JavaScript工具. 审判失败或无答案而结束的,再次运行,只计算被接受的审判.

blocks.en: Judge. ⬇ Your task is to label an answer to a question as ’ CORRECT ’ or ’ WRONG ’ . You will be given the following data : (1) a question ( posed by one user to another user ), (2) a ’ gold ’ ( ground truth ) answer , (3) a generated answer which you will score as CORRECT / WRONG . The point of the question is to ask about something one user should know about the other user based on their prior conversations . The gold answer will usually be a concise and short answer that includes the referenced topic , for example : Question : Do you remember what I got the last time I went to Hawaii ? Gold answer : A shell necklace The generated answer might be much longer , but you should be generous with your grading - as long as it touches on the same topic as the gold answer , it should be counted as CORRECT . For time related questions , the gold answer will be a specific date , month , year , etc . The generated answer might be much longer or use relative time references ( like " last Tuesday " or " next month "), but you should be generous with your grading - as long as it refers to the same date or time period as the gold answer , it should be counted as CORRECT . Even if the format differs ( e . g ., " May 7 th " vs "7 May "), consider it CORRECT if it ' s the same date . Now it ' s time for the real question : Question : { question } Gold answer : { gold_answer } Generated answer : { generated_answer } First , provide a short ( one sentence ) explanation of your reasoning , then finish with CORRECT or WRONG . Do NOT include both CORRECT and WRONG in your response , or it will break the evaluation script . Just return the label CORRECT or WRONG in a json format with the key as " label ".
blocks.zh: 法官。 你的任务是将一个问题的答案标注为 ' 责任 ' 或 ' 错误 ' 。 将给出以下数据:(1) 一个问题(一个用户向另一个用户提问),(2) 一个 ' 黄金 ' (地面真相)回答,(3) 一个生成的答案,你将以 CorrECT / wrong 得分. 问题的关键在于询问一个用户应该根据他们之前的对话了解的关于另一个用户的东西。 金子答案通常会是一个简洁而简短的答案,包括引用的主题,例如: 问题:你还记得我上次去夏威夷时得到了什么吗? 黄金回答: 一条贝壳项链 生成的答案可能要长得多,但你应该宽宏大量地分级,只要它触及与黄金答案相同的话题,就应该算作CORRECHT。 对于与时间相关的问题,黄金答案将是一个具体的日期,月份,年份等. 生成的答案可能更长,或者使用相对时间参考(如 " 上星期二 " 或 " 下个月 " ),但是,你应该慷慨地叙级----只要它提到与黄金答案相同的日期或时间段,它就应该算作CORRECHT。 即使格式不同(e. g., " 5月7日 " 与 " 5月7日 " ),如果是同一日期,也视为 " CORREECT " 。 现在是真正问题的时候了: 问题:{问题} 黄金回答 : {金_答} 生成的答案 : { 生成_ 答案 } 首先, 提供您推理的简短( 一句话) 解释 , 然后用 CorrECT 或 错误 结尾 。 请不要在答复中同时包括CORRECT和错误,否则会破坏评价脚本。 只需以 Json 格式将标签 CORRECT 或 错误 以键作为 " 标签 " 。
